NEW TOWERS Elf Camp - Unlocked from beating the Violent Night Event, the Elf Camp was another pure spawner tower, like the Military Base. For the first two levels, it just spawns Elves that collide with enemies, which are later replaced by Guardian Elves which deal melee damage. At Level 2+, it can start spawning ranged elves, being the Snowball Elves, replaced by the Cannoneer Elf at Level 4, and Gunner Elf at Level 5. At Level 3+, it can start spawning splash elves, being the Bomber Elf, replaced by the Gift Bomber and Ripped Elf at Level 5.
